_readme: Everything a member changes lives here. cut.py reads source/keep/speed; build.py reads the rest. Phrases are matched against the CUT transcript (assets/words-cut.json), case and punctuation ignored, so every phrase below must be words the member really says. Every value is an EXAMPLE showing the shape: Claude fills it from her take before each build. See SPEC.md 'How a member's version differs'.
_keep_note: Source-second ranges to keep, in order (example values): the hook claim, each reason's value sentence, the close.
_snap_readme: Word edges MEASURED from 20 ms RMS around each seam/trigger (whisper runs up to ~0.44 s early after pauses). Key = text@whisper-start (source s, exactly as in words-src.json); value = [start, end] source s, null keeps whisper's. drop = whisper words that are really outside the kept audio. Both start empty.
_caption_fixes_note: Proofreading fixes by cut-word index, e.g. {"0": "Everyone"}.
_colour_note: accent = the member's brand colour (the ONE accent). ink and paper stay.
_hook_note: note = a short handwritten line (her words), hero = 1-3 condensed caps words on tape, stamp = one word slapped on at stamp_on, the hook leaves on out_on. All phrases from the take.
_emphasis_punch_note: Optional: one hard 1.08 punch-in on 'on' inside the hook sentence, back to 1.0 on 'off'. Delete the key for none.
_map_note: on = the promise line that opens the list (e.g. here's why); count = how many numbered points. count 0 and no chapters = no rail.
_chapters_note: One per numbered point the member says. on = where it starts, label = her own words (handwritten), title = a 1-2 word caps title, out_after = the last word of that point's value sentence.
_majors_note: The two full-screen value events. kind accent = a concept field (small line + hero word + handwritten note + drawn bills); kind black = a number counting from 'from' to 'to' that lands on the spoken number, with a tape label. Only numbers she actually says.

majors.phrase: a claim you make about money
